name: zvid_query_texture_memory_bytes
description: zVid::QueryTextureMemoryBytes returns DirectDraw texture-memory totals and free bytes either from the current provider query or from cached hardware API device records.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zVideo DirectDraw memory-query/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4a9a30 validates the null DirectDraw zero/return-zero path, the deviceIndexOrMinus1 == -1 IDirectDraw2::GetAvailableVidMem call through vtable slot 0x5c with DDSCAPS_TEXTURE, the failure zeroing path, and cached record loads at offsets 0x9c and 0xa0 with 0x6ec stride.
Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x4a9a30 has no warnings and matches the implemented provider and cached-table branches.

The native smoke verifies null DirectDraw zeroing, DirectDraw provider success and failure behavior, DDSCAPS_TEXTURE dispatch, cached record total/free bytes, and that cached index queries do not call the provider. The report-error smoke verifies the installed texture-memory query dispatch remains callable by DirectDraw error reporting.
